name: send_message
description: Sends a message via a configured messenger such as Telegram, WhatsApp, Signal or SMS to a Klacks client or, for administrators, to an application user. Call it right away, without asking first: the server shows channel, resolved recipient and text verbatim, and the message goes out only after the user confirms exactly that. Without a provider the single enabled one is used. A name matching several clients returns the candidates; ask which one is meant. Non-admins reach only visible clients.

parameters.name: recipientType
parameters.description: Who to send to: 'client' (default) for a Klacks client, or 'user' for an application user (login account; administrators only).

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: The messaging provider name or type, such as telegram or whatsapp. Optional: for recipientType 'client' the single enabled provider is used when it is omitted (the skill asks when none or several are enabled); for 'user' the user's preferred paired channel is used.

parameters.name: recipient
parameters.description: Who receives the message. For recipientType 'client': a client name, resolved against the messenger contacts of the clients; or a literal phone number or chat ID (for non-admins only one that belongs to a contact of a client they may see); administrators may also use 'mir', 'ich', 'me' or 'myself' for the Klacks owner (Settings -> Owner-Messenger). For recipientType 'user': an application-user name, resolved by name search.

name: read_messages
description: Read recent messages from messaging providers. Shows incoming and outgoing messages with sender, content, and timestamp. Non-admins see only messages of clients they may see; messages without a client are shown to administrators only.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Filter by provider name (e.g., telegram, whatsapp)

parameters.name: sender
parameters.description: Filter by sender phone number or ID

name: list_messaging_providers
description: List all configured messaging providers with their name, type, and enabled status.

name: diagnose_messaging_setup
description: Diagnose why a messaging provider (Telegram, Slack, WhatsApp, Viber, LINE, …) is not working yet and what the admin must do next to put it into operation. Returns a fixed checklist per provider with status and facts. Explain the findings in the user's language, propose only the NextStep of each provider as the concrete action, quote facts such as the webhook URL or an unknown sender id exactly, and never guess causes that are not in the result. Call this directly when the admin asks whether messaging works or why messages do not arrive.

name: send_broadcast
description: Sends one circular to everybody in a group or to a list of employee numbers through one messenger channel, for instance an announcement to the whole team of a branch. Call it once with the group or the numbers: the server finds the people, shows how many it reaches, the channel and the text verbatim, and goes out only after the user confirms exactly that. It works through the whole audience itself and reports delivered, failed and skipped. Non-admins reach only people they may see.

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: ID (GUID) of the group; its subgroups belong to it. Use list_groups to find it. Give either this or idNumbers.

parameters.name: idNumbers
parameters.description: Employee id numbers of the people to reach, instead of a group.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The text of the circular, sent verbatim

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: The messaging provider name or type, such as telegram or whatsapp. Optional: the single enabled provider is used when it is omitted.

name: evaluate_messaging_reach
description: Judges how well a group of employees can be contacted by messenger: how many people each channel reaches, who has no messenger at all, who sits only on a one-way channel without a way to answer, and which switched-off provider would help. Answers who is missing and over which channel the others are reachable. Returns counts, the names of the people without a channel and a computed recommendation, never phone numbers or chat ids. It only reads; relay the recommendation unchanged.

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: ID (GUID) of the group; its subgroups belong to it. Use list_groups to find it. Give either this or idNumbers.

parameters.name: idNumbers
parameters.description: Employee id numbers to judge, instead of a group.
